title: plugin-auth: the invitation role-cap refusals (invite as admin / delegated_admin by a delegated issuer) answer 403 with a message and no `code` — the sibling vendor refusal on the same endpoint carries one
body:
Blocked-by: #24082

**Filing gate ①**: a product defect with a named landing point (ADR-0112 error envelope). **Reach:** public HTTP, `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member`, measured on two separate live boots. This is not an authorization hole: the gate holds and nothing is admitted. The defect is only the refusal's missing machine-readable code.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:identity` (plugin-auth) execution seat:
- pass a stable `code` on the `APIError` thrown in `beforeCreateInvitation` (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`, about line 3422);
- register the code or codes in the ADR-0112 ledger (`error-code-ledger.zod.ts`);
- pin it, for example in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/delegated-admin-invite.dogfood.test.ts`, which already drives this refusal.

## What happens

A delegated issuer is an org member holding `delegated_admin`. When they invite with a role above their grade, the request is refused, which is correct. But the body has no `code`:

| requested role | status | body |
|---|---|---|
| `owner` | 403 | `{"message":"You are not allowed to invite a user with this role","code":"YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_TO_INVITE_USER_WITH_THIS_ROLE"}` (better-auth's own check) |
| `admin` | 403 | `{"message":"[Security] Access denied: you may not invite a member as 'admin' — an invitation can never confer a role above the issuer's own (ADR-0090 D12: administration is a scoped capability)."}`: **no `code`** |
| `delegated_admin` | 403 | `{"message":"[Security] Access denied: a delegated issuer may invite only as 'member' — …"}`: **no `code`** |
| `member` | 200 | invitation pending (control) |

A client, including the console's Invite User dialog that offers these roles, cannot branch on the refusal. It can only show or pattern-match English prose. The owner refusal on the same endpoint does carry a code, so the envelope is inconsistent within one door.

## Reproduction

Run on a stock showcase boot (`objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin`) at `2034975a`, on fresh DBs on two boots:

1. As admin, `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user` with `{"email":"deleg@example.com","name":"Delegate","password":"…"}`. Sign in as the delegate and `POST /api/v1/auth/change-password`, because `mustChangePassword` is set.
2. As admin, `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/update-member-role` with `{"memberId":"DELEGATE_MEMBER_ID","role":"delegated_admin"}`. Confirm with the delegate's `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session`: positions `["delegated_admin","everyone"]`.
3. As the delegate (cookie session), `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member` with `{"email":"x@example.com","role":"admin"}` → **403, body has `message` only**.
4. Same with `"role":"delegated_admin"` → 403, `message` only.
5. Same with `"role":"owner"` → 403 with `code: YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_TO_INVITE_USER_WITH_THIS_ROLE`.

**Expected:** every refusal from this endpoint carries an ADR-0112 `code`.
**Actual:** the two role-cap refusals carry none. No `sys_invitation` row is left behind (correct).

## Mechanism

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-role-cap.ts`, `invitationRoleCapFailure()` (line 131 onward), returns a bare message string from three branches:
  - `requestedGrade > issuerGrade`;
  - `issuerGrade < GRADE_ADMIN` for a non-member role;
  - membership could not be verified.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`, the `beforeCreateInvitation` hook (about line 3422), throws `new APIError('FORBIDDEN', { message: capFailure })` with no `code`, so better-auth serialises the body with `message` alone. The third branch reaches the same throw; it was not triggered live but would carry no code either.

## Dedupe

- MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: `invitation role cap refusal 403 no code field ADR-0112 beforeCreateInvitation delegated issuer` → 8 hits, among them #7725, #8240, #11770, #16582, #16335 and #3697. None reports the missing code on the role-cap refusal.
- Dedupe words: invite-member role cap no code; delegated_admin invite admin 403 message only; ADR-0112 invitation refusal code.
